parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Uh, hello. Amhurst Film Club. This is Daniel speaking. How can I help you today?
Hi there. Um, I’d like to apply for the student membership. I actually live in a little town called Holbrook. That’s H-O-L-B-R-O-O-K.
Right, Holbrook. Thanks for spelling that. So, you’re asking about the student option?
Yeah, I wasn’t sure. You’ve got family and community memberships too, right?
We do, but just to be clear, this package is specifically for students. No other groups.
Oh, okay, great. By the way, I’m 21. Do I still qualify?
Yes, you’re fine. Up until last year, the cutoff was 20, but we raised the maximum to 22 this year.
That’s a relief. Uh, if you need to reach me, could you use my home phone? My mobile’s broken at the moment. The number is 8946 0733.
Got it. And here’s a nice bonus. Members can leave their cars on site without paying anything at all. So parking is completely free.
Oh, that’ll save me some money. Could you, um, tell me what happens during the week?
Sure thing. On Monday, we run a session on the history of the cinema. Basically, how movies have developed, you know, from the silent black and white days through to today’s digital era.
Sounds fascinating. What about midweek?
Let me think. Some people suggested a comedy, but no. On Wednesday, we’ll actually show a horror film.
Oh, okay. That’s fine.
Thursday is more practical. It’s about software, showing you how to develop things like a simple captioning program or a storyboard tool.
That could be useful.
Friday, we sit down with a biography of a famous director. Next month, though, we might swap that for sessions on performing skills. I’ll let everyone know once I have the details.
Great. And what’s on at the weekend?
On Saturday, we run a set of screenings designed especially for teenagers. So mostly young people around 13 to 17 years old.
Perfect. That’s exactly the kind of info I was looking for. Thanks so much.
No problem at all. Welcome aboard.

analyses.content: 申请人说住在一个叫 Holbrook 的小镇，并紧接着进行了逐字母拼写：H-O-L-B-R-O-O-K。
I actually live in a little town called Holbrook. That’s H-O-L-B-R-O-O-K.
注意拼写中的双写字母 O（double O），跟紧录音节奏记录即可。
We do, but just to be clear, this package is specifically for students. No other groups.
不要被前面的 family and community 干扰，那只是申请人询问是否存在这两种会员，被 Daniel 否定了。
Daniel 明确指出这个套餐是专门为 students（学生）准备的，没有其他群体（No other groups）。
Up until last year, the cutoff was 20, but we raised the maximum to 22 this year.
千万别填 20 或 21，20 是去年的标准，21 是申请人自己的年龄。
录音提到去年的截止年龄是 20 岁，但今年把上限提高到了 22 岁，对应题干 upper limit。
The number is 8946 0733.
注意不要期待听到手机号，录音明确说 My mobile’s broken（手机坏了），所以只给了座机号。
申请人让对方打家里的电话，并报出号码 8946 0733。
Members can leave their cars on site without paying anything at all. So parking is completely free.
题目问的是 benefit（福利）包括免费的什么，填 cars 语意不通，填 parking 才是这项服务的名称。
录音说会员可以免费停车（leave their cars on site without paying），最后总结 parking is completely free。
关于周一的安排，录音说会进行一场关于电影 history（历史）的会议（session）。
On Monday, we run a session on the history of the cinema.
不要填 cinema，题干已有 of the cinema，填进去会重复。
Some people suggested a comedy, but no. On Wednesday, we’ll actually show a horror film.
小心干扰项 comedy（喜剧），录音说虽然有人建议，但 no（被否决了）。
关于周三，录音明确说我们将放映一部 horror（恐怖）电影。
Thursday is more practical. It’s about software, showing you how to develop things like a simple captioning program...
不要填 captioning 或 storyboard，那是软件的具体应用示例（things like...），概括性的答案是 software。
周四的内容比较实用，录音说是关于 software（软件）的，教你如何开发东西。
Friday, we sit down with a biography of a famous director.
不要填 performing skills，那是下个月（Next month）可能交换的内容，不是当前的安排。
周五大家会坐下来读一本著名导演的 biography（传记），对应题干 read...。
On Saturday, we run a set of screenings designed especially for teenagers.
虽然录音也提到了 young people 和 13 to 17 years old，但 teenagers 是最准确的概括词，且符合 ONE WORD 的字数限制。
周六的放映是专门为 teenagers（青少年）设计的，对应题干 special films for...。
